svg.title: Home town plan: today, the Round and movement overlay
svg.desc: To scale, Place-local metres. All panels use the same scale; north = −z. Footprints are outside walls, not roofs. TODAY = opening cottages + rooms + forge + layout B station; all build stages. Unused TOWN.wood/stone growth rows and distant camps are excluded. Paint and height cells are baked data; dashed paths are authored centrelines. B1 streets/cottage/yard built; bay and shelf already moved on main (#1778). B2 rooms and balcony built. B3: plots 1–8 and the clock footing stand as blocks. Doors have slab-matching thresholds; yard dressing follows the gift anchor. Distances are straight, horizontal metres, not walked routes or terrain slopes. Forge frame stands on arrival; free finish at F2. Shop/museum boards: arrival. Clock footing 5 × 5 m: arrival; clock: free with trains. Hall tick: town front.
